page.layout: One page of text, no margin notes. Top: printer's ornament above a rule. Then the heading "INDEX EPISTOLARUM.", a centred numeral "I.", and three numbered paragraphs (I, II, III) in the text block. At the foot: a gathering mark "A" (partly under a library stamp) and "IV." at the right. The library stamp is left out.

page.notes: The "A" of the signature is partly covered by the library stamp, so its reading is uncertain. The printer's ornament above the heading is not transcribed. The words "qve" and "qva" are printed with the v-form and are given as "que" and "qua" under the u/v rule; the printed forms are "qvæ", "ritusqve", "simulqve" and "qva". The stamp "BIBLIOTECA NAZ. ROMA" is omitted. Line-end hyphens are kept as printed. No page number or running head is printed.
